text: Cognee exposes four operations: remember, recall, forget, and improve.
Calling remember(text) without a session_id writes directly into the permanent knowledge graph.
recall(query_text) returns up to top_k=5 results by default.
The cognee Python package version is 1.1.0, released in April 2026.
Skills are Markdown (.md) files with YAML frontmatter that declares description and allowed-tools.
Skill improvement proposals are generated when success_score is above the default score_threshold of 0.5.
When improve_skill is called with apply=True, the SkillImprovementProposal can be applied.
With vector_db_provider="redis", Cognee uses Redis as the vector store with default dims=1536 and distance_metric="cosine".
The CLI command is named cognee-ui and supports remember, recall, and forget.
Cognee Cloud is served via await cognee.serve(url="…", api_key="ck_…") and the free tier includes up to 50 MB of stored memory.
